content.text:
HEAD responses from `shelf_router` now keep the original `content-length`. I ran a HEAD request against a route returning `'hello-world'`, and it returned `content-length: 11` with an empty body. The existing `shelf_router` tests also pass. I didn't add a regression test.

The fix is in `pkgs/shelf_router/lib/src/router.dart`. I removed the code in `_removeBody` that overwrote `content-length` with `'0'`, so it now only swaps the body for an empty one. Shelf keeps an explicit `content-length` header when the body is empty, so the value from the GET handler survives. I also added a short doc comment citing RFC 9110 §9.3.2.
